correctness.rationale: The weighted Laplacian decomposes into restricted symmetric, restricted antisymmetric and bipartition-sign eigenspaces of eigenvalues n, p=n−2+2t and q=2(n−1+t), positive for n≥3,t≥0. Exact orbit projection weights give R_{same/matched/cross} and B_{same/matched/cross} with denominators p,n,q and squares. A grounded Green matrix followed by Schur complement proves C=2tr L^+−B/R−(N/4)R with N=2n, so maximizing Φ=B/R+nR/2 orders all pairs. The matched-minus-same difference is −P_n(t) divided by a positive denominator; same-minus-unmatched-cross is strictly positive. Positive cubic derivative coefficients, P_n(0)<0 and P_n(1/2)=n−1>0 give unique c_n and all tie counts. Resistance quadratic root r_n is smaller because P_n(r_n)=−n(n−2)/2<0. Mean-value control on P_n′ and the explicit radical prove n(c_n−r_n)→1/4. Direct exact rational n=3,t=2/5 example yields resistance 1/108 and coherence 5/342 of opposing signs. Independent SymPy simplification confirmed cubic orbit score identity; 27 exact direct inverses of follower matrices for n=3..5/t=0,2/5,1 and three pair-orbits confirmed formula. Finite matrices corroborate, not replace, the all-n polynomial proof.
